messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU decode OOM spike observed in streaming pool us-east-1b. Error rate >10% for decode workers. Paging @mike_oncall and @kevin_sre.

mike_oncall: Acked. Jumping on the call in 2. Turning on quiet-mode for alerts :headphones:

kevin_sre: quick summary: multiple decode containers hitting CUDA OOM within same 3m window. Pattern looks like runaway generation (clients sending huge max_tokens / missing cap). Telemetry shows token_count for some sessions >> configured cap.

olga_ml: seeing repeated tail generation on a handful of request IDs. Sample trace: `req=xyZ-1234` produced continuous decode with no EOS; client header `x-client-max-tokens: 1e6` (malformed).

dana_support: we have 5 customer tickets mentioning dropped responses in last 10m, two marked high. Notified one impacted enterprise (acct ACME-42). They saw ~20% failed responses.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigation steps: 1) Enable per-request max_tokens enforcement at proxy; 2) Route suspicious long-run requests to throttled fallback model; 3) Temporarily increase decode pool by +2 nodes in us-east-1b. Applying step 1 now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/_admin/limits -d '{"enforce_max_tokens":true}'`

deploy-bot: rollout started: enforce_max_tokens flag -> canary (10% traffic) at 6173334570.

kevin_sre: canary looks good, enforcing caps prevents OOM repros in canary containers. Pushing to 100% now. Also dropping overly long in-flight requests: `kill -9` loop for hung decode processes that exceeded 120s.

mike_oncall: step 2 completed: route header-misbehaving traffic to `small-decoder-v1` with token cap 512. Config applied to routing rule `stream-fallback-v2`.

olga_ml: added a sanitizer to reject insane `x-client-max-tokens` values at edge (threshold 100k). Also logging token histogram per request for post-incident analysis.

dana_support: emailed ACME-42 with interim status: mitigation applied, we are continuing to monitor. They asked for ETA on full root cause and whether data was affected (answer: no data exfiltration).

kevin_sre: metrics now: OOM rate down from 11.3% to 0.9% in last 5m post-rollout. Request drop count increased briefly during remediation due to in-flight kills (~430 dropped), majority from malformed clients.

mike_oncall: customer impact summary for now: ~0.6% of total requests dropped during 20m window; two enterprise customers saw higher spikes. Recommend follow-up comms and a postmortem.

olga_ml: queued an eval to replay a sample of the runaway sessions to verify degradation/regression. Will attach prompt set to the incident doc.

kevin_sre: action items assigned: (1) short-term: keep enforce_max_tokens on by default for 72h; (2) mid-term: add per-tenant hard cap + circuit breaker for token storm; (3) long-term: improve client-side SDK validation and include sane defaults.

mike_oncall: handing off to oncall-secondary @kevin_sre for overnight monitoring. I'll draft the post-incident notes and customer update.

dana_support: I'll follow-up with ACME-42 with the mitigation summary and offer a technical postmortem call.

kevin_sre: marking incident as contained. Will open follow-up ticket for root cause analysis and telemetry gaps.

incident-bot: Incident status -> CONTAINED. Paging channel will remain open for 1h for watch.

mike_oncall: closing call. Thanks all. :checkered_flag:
